svg.text: FireSim + Vortex — software and hardware stack
One stack, two vehicles: the card (left of the red cut: PCIe) and the in-process metasimulator (right: the same design, Verilated). Every layer above the cut is identical in both.
Host process (one per run)
Application — tests/regression/<app>
vx_dev_open / vx_mem_alloc / vx_copy_to_dev / vx_start / vx_ready_wait, linked against libvortex.so
Runtime HAL — sw/runtime/firesim/vortex.cpp → libvortex-firesim.so
Driver ABI + software command processor (cmd_processor.cpp); kernel upload, DCR writes, launch, flush
VRT_VBIN_PATH / XCLBIN_PATH · VORTEX_FIRESIM_ARGS → extra plusargs (+mm_…)
Transport — sim/firesim/firesim_sim.cpp (in libfiresim.so)
Owns the simulator thread; every bridge call is a labelled request marshalled onto it.
Adaptive step batching, DCR single-step polling, launch watchdog, stall reports
FireSim driver core — $(FIRESIM_PATH)/sim/midas/src/main/cc
Widget registry from FireSim-generated.const.h:
peek_poke_t · loadmem_t · clockmodule_t · FASEDMemoryTimingModel (driver half)
simif_t: MMIO read/write + bulk memory, one implementation per vehicle
simif_aved (VRT)
V80: vrtd programs the PDI,
MMIO over PCIe BAR
simif_vitis (XRT)
U55C: xclbin load,
MMIO + DMA through XRT
Metasimulator (TARGET=xrtsim / avedsim) — no card, no image
Same application · same runtime HAL · same transport
Built with -DFIRESIM_EMUL; libfiresim.so is the Verilated model itself
simif_emul — the emulated host interface
MMIO and DMA become DPI calls into the Verilated top (top.sv / emul);
firesim_emul_main.cpp runs Verilator's event loop on the simulator thread.
VORTEX_FIRESIM_EMUL_ARGS → +waveformfile=… +max-cycles=… (EMUL_DEBUG=1 build)
Vemul — the whole FPGA payload, Verilated
FireSim-generated.sv + (unthreaded builds) the flattened Vortex tree,
bit-identical to what the card synthesizes. Same tokens, same schedule:
what passes here passes on silicon, cycle for cycle.
FAME5=1: Vortex is already inside FireSim-generated.sv (converted to
FIRRTL and threaded), so Verilator is handed no Vortex sources at all.
Build: sw/runtime/firesim → sim/firesim/Makefile (EMUL_DIR per card,
_fame5 and _dbg variants); run: blackbox.sh --driver=firesim
--target=avedsim|xrtsim [FAME5=1] [EMUL_DEBUG=1]
PCIe — MMIO (control) + memory writes; everything below is on the FPGA
FPGA (V80 shown; U55C differs only in the shell)
Shell — AVED static region + AvedShim / SimulationMaster
PCIe endpoint, AXI-Lite control (16 B blocks), host clock, HBM NoC — see the FPGA architecture figure
FPGATop — FireSim's generated harness (FireSim-generated.sv)
Bridges: PeekPoke (ctrl_* ports) · LoadMem (bulk memory) · ClockBridge · FASED (memory timing)
Token channels host-decouple everything inside; the target advances only when stepped.
Target — VortexDUT ▸ VX_firesim_wrap ▸ Vortex
The design under test: DCR + start/busy control surface, one 512-bit AXI4 memory port.
FAME5=1: the sockets inside are time-multiplexed through one physical copy.
